newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: NZ s/adj retail sales fall 4.6 percent in May.
newsitem.headline: NZ s/adj retail sales fall 4.6 percent in May.

text.p: Statistics New Zealand (SNZ) on Thursday released the following retail sales data for May.
Revised from figures are in brackets.
Total actual retail sales (percentage change from same month

Economists polled by Reuters on average forecast seasonally adjusted retail sales to fall 2.61 percent in May. Their forecasts ranged from a 1.0 percent fall to a 4.5 percent fall, with a median of -3.0 percent.

Economists on average forecast total actual retail sales to fall by 3.53 percent in the May year. Their forecasts ranged from a rise of 0.8 percent to a fall of 3.0 percent, with a median of -1.5 percent.
